scope: First funded public-testnet exchange: Zcash public testnet (Ironwood, NU7 branch 77190ad9) and Ethereum Sepolia. One host runs both owner clients; observations use trusted RPC providers. Not a consensus or finality proof, not independent hosts, not mainnet.

transactions.step: F: source note to the shared note
C: Bob completes the adaptor signature and claims ZEC

refund_auxiliary.meaning: The settled swap put only F and C on the Zcash chain, both with no transparent input or output.

integration_defects_found_and_fixed_duri: Source freshness compared whole-second time with a millisecond observation and refused same-second observations as future (scripts/source_inputs.py).
public_launch.py passed the presign output directory as the presignature file, and re-exported an existing review on rerun (now verified for equality).

The source preflight synced the wallet before the slow Ethereum checks, so a new Zcash block usually invalidated the tip check; it now scans immediately before the provider query and rescans at most three times (scripts/public_source.py).
The ETH reserve check refused when Sepolia's suggested gas price lagged just below the base fee; it now requires the signed ceiling to cover both (scripts/public_evm_observation.py).
Earlier the same night: gas limits re-derived for current Sepolia (deploy 5.09M, lock 0.80M actually used); dRPC dropped free Sepolia; publicnode prunes genesis.
operational_notes: Tenderly's gateway rate-limited two sends (HTTP 429); the exact same signed bytes were resubmitted through publicnode with the same hash.
Every defect stopped a check before any send; no transaction was lost or duplicated.
limits: Both owners ran on one host and OS account; not independent administration.
Trusted RPC providers (Tenderly, publicnode, testnet.zec.rocks); provider finality labels are not local consensus verification.
Only the success path ran publicly; the no-reveal refund path (with the deferred auxiliary A) has not run on the public networks.
